{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent inclusion criterion numbering",
      "quote": "5. Able to provide tissue from a core or excisional/incisional biopsy (fine needle aspirate is not sufficient). A fresh tissue biopsy (within 90 days before the start of study treatment) is preferred but an archival sample is acceptable (as a substitute) if no intervening therapy was received. If the Investigator believes it is unsafe to perform a biopsy, the subject may be considered eligible after discussion with the Medical Monitor if tissue and/or prior assessments are available to determine programmed death-ligand 1 expression.\n6. NOTE: for tissue sampling details, please refer to the laboratory manual.",
      "page": 7,
      "section": "5.2 Inclusion Criteria",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The inclusion criteria list has a 'NOTE' as item 6, which is not a criterion but a cross-reference. This disrupts the numbering and could cause confusion when referencing criteria (e.g., 'criterion 6' is not a real criterion).",
      "fix": "Renumber the criteria so that the NOTE is not numbered as a criterion, or move the NOTE to a separate paragraph."
    },
    {
      "title": "Contraception section referenced but not provided",
      "quote": "Women of childbearing potential must have negative serum pregnancy test before dosing at W1D1 and be willing to use an adequate method of contraception (Section 4.3.2.) from the time of consent until at least 150 days after last dose of study treatment.",
      "page": 7,
      "section": "5.2 Inclusion Criteria",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol references 'Section 4.3.2' for contraception details, but the provided text does not include that section. The M11 template requires a dedicated 'Contraception' section (5.4) which is missing. This leaves the contraception requirements incomplete.",
      "fix": "Add a detailed contraception section (e.g., M11 5.4) specifying acceptable methods, duration, and male contraception requirements, and update the cross-reference."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent exclusion criterion for prior radiation",
      "quote": "Received radiation therapy (or other nonsystemic therapy) within 2 weeks before first dose of study treatment on W1D1. Subjects should have recovered (ie, Grade ≤1 or at Baseline) from radiation-related toxicities.",
      "page": 8,
      "section": "5.3 Exclusion Criteria",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The exclusion criterion says radiation within 2 weeks is exclusionary, but the inclusion criterion 4c requires 'Documented disease progression in any lesion that was previously radiated in order to serve as a target lesion.' This is not necessarily contradictory, but the protocol does not clarify whether a previously radiated lesion that has progressed can be used as a target lesion if radiation was within 2 weeks. The wording could be ambiguous.",
      "fix": "Clarify that progression in a previously radiated lesion is acceptable even if radiation was within 2 weeks, provided the lesion is not the one being irradiated."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing trial stopping rules",
      "quote": "All enrolled subjects will receive CMP-001 IT and nivolumab IV according to the treatment schedule until a reason for treatment discontinuation is reached.",
      "page": 6,
      "section": "4.1 Description of Trial Design",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The protocol mentions 'until a reason for treatment discontinuation is reached' but does not specify any trial-level stopping rules (e.g., for safety, futility, or efficacy). The M11 template requires a dedicated section on trial stopping rules (4.3), which is missing. This is a critical gap for a phase 2 oncology trial.",
      "fix": "Add a section on trial stopping rules, including criteria for early termination due to safety (e.g., number of DLTs) or futility (e.g., ORR threshold)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing start and end of trial definitions",
      "quote": "This is a multicenter, open-label, Phase 2 clinical study of CMP-001 administered by IT injection in combination with intravenous (IV) nivolumab in subjects with unresectable or metastatic melanoma refractory to prior programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1) blockade.",
      "page": 6,
      "section": "4.1 Description of Trial Design",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not define the start of the trial (e.g., date of first subject's first visit) or the end of the trial (e.g., last subject's last visit or database lock). This is required by M11 4.4 and is important for regulatory and operational clarity.",
      "fix": "Add a statement defining the start of trial (e.g., first subject signed informed consent) and end of trial (e.g., last subject's last protocol-specified assessment or study completion)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing post-trial access to intervention",
      "quote": "All enrolled subjects will receive CMP-001 IT and nivolumab IV according to the treatment schedule until a reason for treatment discontinuation is reached.",
      "page": 6,
      "section": "4.1 Description of Trial Design",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not describe whether subjects will have access to CMP-001 or nivolumab after the trial ends (e.g., continued access, compassionate use, or extension study). M11 4.5 requires this information, and it is missing.",
      "fix": "Add a section on post-trial access, stating whether continued treatment is available and under what conditions."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent definition of 'refractory' in inclusion criteria",
      "quote": "Refractory to PD-1 blockade either as monotherapy or in combination with other therapies, as defined by the following criteria:\na. Received treatment with a Food and Drug Administration approved PD-1 blocking antibody for 12 weeks or longer.\nb. Have PD (according to RECIST v1.1) within 12 weeks of the last dose of a PD-1 blocking antibody, either as monotherapy or in combination with other agents.",
      "page": 6,
      "section": "5.2 Inclusion Criteria",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The inclusion criteria require PD within 12 weeks of last dose, but the protocol does not specify whether this is based on BICR or Investigator assessment. Later, the primary endpoint uses BICR, but the inclusion criteria say 'by Investigator assessment' for the confirmatory assessment. This could lead to inconsistency in determining eligibility.",
      "fix": "Clarify whether the PD for eligibility is based on Investigator or BICR assessment, and ensure consistency with the primary endpoint assessment."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing lifestyle restrictions",
      "quote": "Treatment with complementary medications (eg, herbal supplements or traditional Chinese medicines) to treat the disease under study within 2 weeks before start of study treatment. Refer to Section 4.4. for prohibited therapies.",
      "page": 8,
      "section": "5.3 Exclusion Criteria",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The protocol mentions prohibited therapies but does not include a dedicated section on lifestyle restrictions (e.g., alcohol, smoking, diet, sexual activity) as required by M11 5.5. This is a minor gap but could be important for a study with an IT injection and immunotherapy.",
      "fix": "Add a section on lifestyle restrictions, including any prohibitions on alcohol, smoking, or other activities that could affect safety or PK."
    }
  ]
}
